text: This solution, IBRD Catastrophe Bonds for Earthquakes and Tropical Cyclones addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Philippines between Republic of the Philippines (Department of Finance; National Treasury), World Bank (IBRD), GC Securities, Swiss Re Capital Markets, Munich Re Capital Markets, and AIR Worldwide (now Verisk Extreme Event Solutions). The program was implemented in 2019 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
